parsed_json.up: Select canonical_smiles from compound_structures, substrate_compound_name from compound_records.compound_name, parent_compound_name from molecule_dictionary.pref_name via molecule_hierarchy.parent_molregno, met_conversion, and pathway_key from metabolism. Join metabolism to compound_records on metabolism.substrate_record_id = compound_records.record_id, then to compound_structures on compound_records.molregno = compound_structures.molregno, then to molecule_hierarchy on compound_records.molregno = molecule_hierarchy.molregno, then to molecule_dictionary on molecule_hierarchy.parent_molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno. Do not deduplicate. Sort by canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key. Limit to first 200 rows.
